4. R1

**Fail.** The decisive passage is the headline replacement:

> Before: “Mätförsöket i Björkskolan visar när, inte varför”
>
> After: “Björkskolans mätvärden behöver kopplas till användningstider”

The reply justifies it with “Rubriken upprepade ingressens slutsats om när respektive varför.” This does not identify a concrete visible defect under the frozen expectation. It replaces a working headline's claim about evidential limits with advice. The original limitation surviving in the standfirst and body prevents an article-wide factual loss, but does not authorize a taste-driven change to the headline.

The lead rewrite adds another unnecessary correction, justified by “Brödtextens första mening behövde ingressen för att identifiera de 14 passen.” Its original reference was compatible with the independent standfirst and its denominator-based inference was already sound. The inference remains sound after editing; preservation of that inference is credited separately from the unjustified rewrite.

The failure is therefore unsupported intervention in working text, not an invented measurement claim, lost quotation, funding distortion, prohibited numeric finding, technique selection or mechanical proofreading issue. There are no legitimate removals or irreparable findings that would justify either substantive edit.
